claims.text: The hotel is located between West Bay and the Old City, close to Souq Waqif, the Corniche, the National Museum of Qatar, the Museum of Islamic Art and the Msheireb Museums.

findings.quote: We are strategically located between West Bay and the Old City, with proximity to Souq Waqif, Corniche, Qatar National Museum, Museum of Islamic Art and Musheireb Museums.

claims.text: The hotel offers easy access to the Doha Metro.

findings.quote: The hotel’s prime position offers guests easy access to key commercial and residential areas as well as the Doha Metro.

claims.text: Rooms and suites blend contemporary luxury design with Arabic influences.

findings.quote: Our elegant hotel rooms and suites seamlessly blend contemporary luxury design with distinct Arabic influences.

claims.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling glass windows with views of Doha.

findings.quote: Admire clear, unobstructed views of Doha through expansive floor-to-ceiling glass windows.

claims.text: Rooms and suites offer views of the Arabian Gulf, gardens and Doha's historic old city.

findings.quote: each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, verdant gardens, and Doha's historical old city

claims.text: Bathrooms each have a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.

findings.quote: elegant bathrooms, each with its own separate bathtub and walk-in shower

claims.text: Harmony Sky Suite guests receive club benefits.

findings.quote: Guests enjoy exclusive club benefits

claims.text: The Bliss Signature Suite has panoramic views of the bay or the oasis.

findings.quote: where calming interiors meet panoramic views of the bay or the oasis beyond

claims.text: The spa combines its signature treatments with hydrothermal facilities in The Rainforest.

findings.quote: combining the best of its signature spa treatments with its state-of-the-art hydrothermal facilities within The Rainforest

claims.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool and an indoor pool with a jet spa.

findings.quote: Swim beneath the sun in our outdoor pool or relax in our indoor pool and jet spa after a long day out.

claims.text: The hotel has a fully equipped fitness centre and a Kids Club.

findings.quote: such as a fully-equipped fitness centre and a Kids Club

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants serve modern Thai, Italian and Indian cuisine.

findings.quote: From modern Thai cuisine to unique Italian and Indian creations

claims.text: The spa has separate male and female areas with treatment rooms, heated beds, a vitality pool with a Jacuzzi, relaxation areas, a brine steam room, a herbal sauna and a rain walk.

findings.quote: The spa features exclusive male and female spaces equipped with treatment rooms, heated beds, a vitality pool complete with a Jacuzzi, relaxation areas, a brine steam room, a herbal sauna and a rain walk.

claims.text: The Harmony Sky Suite has panoramic views of Doha, a separate dining room, a living area, a bedroom with a walk-in closet and a bathroom with views.

findings.quote: where panoramic views of Doha meet elegant interiors designed for luxurious living
This expansive suite features a separate dining room, a spacious living area, a grand bedroom with a walk-in closet, and a bathroom offering breathtaking views.

claims.text: Set within Doha Oasis, the hotel has direct access to the indoor theme park Quest and the Printemps Doha department store.

findings.quote: Nestled within Doha Oasis, we provide direct access to the indoor theme park Quest and the largest luxury department store in the Middle East, Printemps Doha

claims.text: The property's design combines traditional Asian principles with Arabian heritage.

findings.quote: Every detail of the property represents a harmony of traditional Asian principles and rich Arabian heritage

claims.text: Vertigo is a club on level 28 with 360-degree views of Doha.

findings.quote: Located on level 28, Vertigo Doha is one of the highest clubs in the Mushaireb area with incredible 360-degree views of Doha’s Skyline, Corniche, and old city.

claims.text: The hotel is in the city rather than on the sea; guests have free access to West Bay Beach, a 10-minute drive from the hotel.

findings.quote: Guests can enjoy free access to West Bay Beach which is only 10-min drive from the hotel.
findings.note: Beach is a drive away, implying the hotel is not on the sea.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of Mushaireb, Banyan Tree Doha is a premier 5-star hotel

claims.text: Rooms and suites do not have balconies, while all the residences do.

findings.quote: We don’t have balconies in the rooms and Suites. However, all our residences have balconies.
While the spacious suites with private balconies offer plenty of space for large families to relax in style.
findings.note: Editorial review claims suites have private balconies.
